_comment: Single source of truth for the Workbox precache glob set. Consumed by ui/vite.config.ts (injectManifest) and scripts/pwa/check-precache-budget.mjs (CI budget gate). Keep both in sync by editing here only. Editor-only chunks (OpenPolotno: PolotnoDesignStudio-*, and its shared vendor chunk config-*, named after openpolotno/config) runtime-cache instead of precaching.
